name: Baked Honey-Garlic Chicken Thighs
summary: Bone-in chicken thighs baked in a honey, soy, and garlic glaze, served over rice. Mix, pour, bake.
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Arrange the thighs skin-side up in a baking dish.
Stir together the honey, soy sauce, garlic, and pepper. Pour it over the chicken.
Bake 40–45 minutes, spooning the sauce over the chicken once halfway through, until the skin is dark and the thickest piece reads 175°F (80°C).
While it bakes, cook the rice: 300 g rice with 600 mL water, simmered covered for 15 minutes.
Serve the thighs over rice with the pan sauce spooned on top.

substitutions.costNote: A small bottle of tamari is about $3–$4; you use a quarter of it

glutenFree.notes: Chicken, honey, garlic, and rice are naturally gluten-free. Soy sauce is the only ingredient with wheat.

budgetNotes: Bone-in, skin-on thighs at $8.82/kg are less than half the price of boneless and stay juicier in the oven.
There's no vegetable in the base recipe to keep it under $15. Frozen mixed vegetables ($0.90 for 200 g) would bring it to about $13.90.
Line the dish with foil. The honey burns onto the pan otherwise.

pricingMetadata.notes: Bone-in skin-on chicken thighs $8.82/kg (club pack; 1.2 kg = $10.58). Honey $9.98/1 kg (Billy Bee, Walmart regular, November 2026; estimate, not in validated table). Soy sauce $0.51/100 mL (No Name). Garlic $0.08/clove. Rice $0.25/100 g.
